title.zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 确认遭网络攻击，此前 ZachXBT 将其与 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案关联
title.en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft

current_state.zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 在服务提供商平台遭入侵后已基本恢复运营；客户资金未受影响，但银行自有资金被盗并仍在评估损失。部分与交易所提款相关的资金已被冻结，追回工作仍在进行。
current_state.en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa has largely resumed operations after a service-provider breach; customer funds were unaffected, but the bank's own funds were stolen and the financial impact is still being assessed. Some funds linked to exchange withdrawals have been frozen, with recovery efforts ongoing.

updates.title_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 确认遭网络攻击，此前 ZachXBT 将其与 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案关联
updates.title_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
updates.what_changed_zh:
法国银行集团 Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 周三向 Decrypt 发表声明，确认其遭遇了一次使欺诈性操作得以进行的网络攻击，称事件已“关闭并处于控制之下”，业务正在逐步恢复。这一确认出现在链上调查员 ZachXBT 公开指认该行为超过 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案疑似受害方的次日。

该行表示在发现攻击后立即通报了相关监管机构，并作为预防措施暂停了部分交易。ZachXBT 则指责该机构未进行“适当的事件披露”，称这导致执法部门无法冻结约 3000 万美元被盗资金。

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 未提及加密货币，也未说明被盗金额，称受影响金额仍在评估中，但“无论如何都不足以动摇集团的稳健性与财务健康”；该行称客户资产未受影响，只是部分转账执行被延迟。ZachXBT 最初指出 11 月 1 日有逾 1.06 亿美元从交易所账户被提走，随后追加 2700 万美元，并公布了四个以太坊地址，还表示可以“高度确信”攻击者并非 Lazarus 组织。
updates.what_changed_en:
French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed in a statement to Decrypt on Wednesday that it was hit by a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent operations, saying the incident is "closed and now under control" and that operations are resuming gradually. The confirmation came one day after onchain investigator ZachXBT publicly named the bank as the alleged victim of a crypto theft exceeding $133 million.

The bank said it alerted the relevant supervisory authorities as soon as it detected the attack and temporarily suspended some transactions as a precaution. ZachXBT accused the institution of failing to make a "proper incident disclosure," which he said prevented law enforcement from freezing some $30 million in stolen funds.

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa did not mention crypto or state how much was taken, saying the affected amounts are still being assessed but are "in any event not of a nature to call into question the solidity and financial health of the group"; it said customer assets were unaffected and some transfers were only delayed. ZachXBT initially flagged more than $106 million in withdrawals from exchange accounts on November 1, later added $27 million, published four Ethereum addresses, and said he could state "with a high degree of confidence" the attacker is not the Lazarus Group.

updates.background_zh: 据其官网介绍，Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 是一家法国互助银行集团，由 Crédit Mutuel de Bretagne 与 Crédit Mutuel du Sud-Ouest 两大联合会及约 40 家专业子公司组成，拥有约 500 万客户；ZachXBT 则称其是一家资产规模 2350 亿美元的法国银行。今年 5 月，法国财经媒体 L'Agefi 报道称，该集团已根据欧盟加密规则 MiCA 申请牌照，以便向零售客户提供加密服务，并通过其 Arkéa Banking Services 部门提供白标服务。ZachXBT 未说明他是如何识别出该银行的，也未说明攻击者如何进入其交易所账户。
updates.background_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa is a French mutual banking group made up of the Crédit Mutuel de Bretagne and Crédit Mutuel du Sud-Ouest federations plus around 40 specialized subsidiaries, with about 5 million customers, according to its own website; ZachXBT described it as a French bank with $235 billion in assets. In May, French financial newspaper L'Agefi reported that the group had applied for a license under MiCA, the EU's crypto rulebook, to offer crypto services to retail customers and on a white-label basis through its Arkéa Banking Services division. ZachXBT did not say how he identified the bank or how the attacker gained access to its exchange accounts.
updates.market_impact_zh: 疑似赃款以从交易所账户提取的 USDC 和 USDT 形式流出，随后兑换为 ETH、经即时交易平台转移、部分转为门罗币并跨多条链桥接——这一洗钱路径涉及中心化平台的稳定币流动性、跨链桥以及隐私币市场。与此同时，在该集团申请 MiCA 牌照的背景下，此案也使欧盟的事件披露实践与银行系加密托管受到关注，这一渠道会影响机构对欧洲受监管加密准入的情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: The alleged proceeds moved as USDC and USDT withdrawn from exchange accounts, then swapped into ETH, routed through instant exchanges, partly converted to Monero and bridged across multiple chains — a laundering path that touches stablecoin liquidity at centralized venues, cross-chain bridges and privacy-coin markets. The case also puts EU incident-disclosure practices and bank-linked crypto custody in focus as the group pursues a MiCA license, a channel that affects institutional sentiment toward regulated crypto access in Europe.

updates.title_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 在遭受攻击后恢复运营，并评估损失
updates.title_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充称，攻击者是通过一家服务提供商（而非该行在线银行子公司 Fortuneo）进入系统的，并转走了银行自有资金；该行几乎所有业务已于周三恢复，但仍在评估财务影响。报道还称 Bitquery 追踪到从 Kraken、Crypto.com 和 OKX 账户提走的资金，部分资金已被冻结，后续追回工作正在进行中。
updates.what_changed_en: The new report adds that attackers gained access through a service provider, not the bank's online banking subsidiary Fortuneo, and transferred the bank's own funds; nearly all operations resumed Wednesday while the bank is still assessing the financial impact. It also says Bitquery traced withdrawals from accounts at Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX, some funds were frozen, and further recovery efforts are underway.

Some funds linked to exchange withdrawals have been frozen, with recovery efforts ongoing.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa restored nearly all operations after a service-provider breach let attackers steal about $133M of the bank's own funds and push them through crypto exchange withdrawals traced by Bitquery to Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa restored nearly all operations after a service-provider breach let attackers steal about $133M of the bank's own funds and push them through crypto exchange withdrawals traced by Bitquery to Kraken, Crypto.com and OKX.
